instruction: A candid action photograph shows a full shot in a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio. The female ballet dancer in a black long-sleeved top and white tutu (R1) balances on pointe in the center, facing left. The male ballet dancer in a black unitard (R2) stands closely behind her, leaning forward and holding her waist with both hands to support her. Soft, natural light from the background windows illuminates the scene.
